claim: OpenAI's Preparedness Framework v1 (Dec 2024) tracks capabilities in four categories: cybersecurity, CBRN, persuasion, and model autonomy.

source.excerpt: Our Preparedness Framework tracks capabilities across four categories: cybersecurity, CBRN, persuasion, and model autonomy. We track these at low, medium, high, and critical levels.

provenance.context: OpenAI Preparedness Framework v1 (Dec 2024). URL: https://openai.com/index/preparedness/

claim: OpenAI's Preparedness Framework v1 commits to board-level review of models crossing 'high' capability thresholds before deployment.

source.excerpt: Models crossing the 'high' capability threshold require board-level review before deployment.

provenance.context: OpenAI Preparedness Framework v1, §3 Deployment governance. URL: https://openai.com/index/preparedness/

claim: OpenAI's Preparedness Framework v2 (Apr 2025) added a 'critical' capability level and a 2x compute cadence for re-evaluation.

source.excerpt: v2 adds a critical capability level above high. Models crossing critical capability thresholds are not deployable without further mitigations.

provenance.context: OpenAI Preparedness Framework v2 (Apr 2025 update). URL: https://cdn.openai.com/pdf/openai-preparedness-framework-v2.pdf

claim: OpenAI operated a Red Team Network of external researchers throughout 2024-2025, focused on jailbreak resistance and CBRN uplift.

source.excerpt: Our Red Team Network includes external researchers focused on jailbreak resistance and CBRN uplift studies.

provenance.context: OpenAI Red Team Network Update (June 2025). URL: https://openai.com/index/red-team-network-update-2025

claim: OpenAI's o3 system card (April 2025) reported 'medium' capability for CBRN and 'high' for cybersecurity in internal evaluations.

source.excerpt: We assess o3 as medium capability for CBRN and high capability for cybersecurity based on our evaluations.

claim: OpenAI submitted a Winter 2025 FLI Index survey response addressing transparency on whistleblower protections and external model evaluations.

source.excerpt: OpenAI submitted a response to the FLI Winter 2025 survey.

provenance.context: FLI AI Safety Index Winter 2025 Appendix A. URL: https://futureoflife.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/AI-Safety-Index-Report_131225_Full_Report_Digital.pdf

claim: OpenAI dissolved its Superalignment team in May 2024, with members redistributing across research and policy roles.

source.excerpt: OpenAI's Superalignment team, originally focused on alignment of superintelligent systems, was dissolved in May 2024 with members moving to other research areas.

provenance.context: OpenAI Superalignment team status (May 2024 reports). URL: https://openai.com/index/superalignment-team-update/
